status_note: P1-P7 are candidate delivery packages for professional review, not procurement, funding, staffing or operating commitments.

packages.name_zh: 四时应答线导视与人工求助
packages.name_en: Seasonal Response Line wayfinding and human help
packages.spatial_carrier: Seasonal Response Line and three node approaches
packages.objective: Make version, source, opening information and ordinary help reachable without AI or login.
packages.candidate_lead: accessibility specialist + community operator; to verify
prerequisites: official boundary and safe walking survey
kpi_proposal: ordinary help route available in every tested period
packages.stop_and_fallback: Stop on unsafe or misleading information; withdraw the version and retain static signs, phone, paper and staffed help.

packages.name_zh: 一刻回声站与居民反馈
packages.name_en: One-Minute Echo Station and resident feedback
packages.objective: Collect voluntary public corrections and requests with a visible human response loop.
packages.candidate_lead: community deliberation facilitator + operator; to verify
kpi_proposal: all accepted entries receive status and route
packages.stop_and_fallback: Stop collection if field use or responsibility is unclear; use a paper suggestion box and staffed response only.

packages.spatial_carrier: Zhongzhiyuan AI Acceleration Area conceptual interface
packages.objective: Test public questions, model drafts and human sign-off in a small, reversible industry-facing setting.
packages.candidate_lead: test coordinator + professional reviewer + participating enterprise; to verify
kpi_proposal: no automatic eligibility or public-resource decision
packages.stop_and_fallback: Stop on re-identification, unfair treatment or unexplained output; delete affected test data and return to manual issue intake.

packages.name_zh: 秋声庭文化双语与无障碍导览
packages.name_en: Autumn Echo Yard bilingual and accessible culture
packages.spatial_carrier: Beijing AI Origin Community conceptual interface
packages.objective: Publish source-traceable Jingzhang, Zhongguancun and AI-culture narratives with text, audio and human alternatives.
packages.candidate_lead: culture editor + bilingual reviewer + accessibility specialist; to verify
kpi_proposal: three review signatures for ordinary published items
packages.stop_and_fallback: Withdraw disputed or uncited copy; restore the last verified short text and human explanation.

packages.name_zh: 冬灯台小企业服务与夜间提示
packages.name_en: Winter Light Porch small-business service and evening prompts
packages.spatial_carrier: Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster conceptual interface
packages.objective: Offer a low-threshold business/public interface for evening information, service questions and non-AI assistance.
packages.candidate_lead: small-business service operator + safety/accessibility reviewer; to verify
kpi_proposal: manual service offered for every published time window
no public output from unreviewed business data
packages.stop_and_fallback: Stop evening prompts during safety or staffing failure; keep static opening information and staffed/phone service.

packages.spatial_carrier: Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin Community and open online/offline rooms
packages.objective: Turn public questions into bounded, reviewable challenges without promising admission, procurement or investment.
packages.candidate_lead: developer-community coordinator + public-interest reviewer; to verify
kpi_proposal: every challenge has scope, reviewer and fallback
all participants receive equal withdrawal route
packages.stop_and_fallback: Cancel or pause a challenge when scope, rights or human review is missing; provide a public explanation and ordinary feedback channel.

packages.name_zh: 三节点换挡账本与年度公示
packages.name_en: Three-Node Shift Ledger and annual disclosure
packages.spatial_carrier: three nodes plus the public evidence workspace
packages.objective: Keep versions, sources, human sign-off, incidents, changes, withdrawals and next-cycle decisions traceable.
packages.candidate_lead: evidence steward + community oversight group; to verify
prerequisites: quarterly review and annual disclosure route
kpi_proposal: every active version has source, reviewer and rollback path
annual disclosure completed or reason published
packages.stop_and_fallback: Freeze new versions when the ledger, reviewer or rollback path is incomplete; keep the last verified public information and human service.
